flagged.title: Ozymandias — Power & Its Decay
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly teaches students to identify plosive sounds in the phrase 'half sunk, a shattered visage lies', which misidentifies linguistic features and would cost marks in a GCSE English Literature language analysis question.

mark_affecting.quote: Plosive & Sibilance... Plosives are those hard, explosive sounds, like 'p' and 'b'... Let's look back at the phrases 'half sunk' and 'shattered'. Shelley is deliberately combining these sounds to mimic violent destruction.
